inputs.basis: 2 upload parts (32 MiB first buffer, then 16 MiB); the parts before the failing one once, the failing last part (1 + 1)^2 = 4 times with s3_retry_attempts = 1; one AbortMultipartUpload

PutObject.reason: the files written before the failure surfaces depend on the writer order; the temporary part is removed after it

DeleteObjects.reason: the files written before the failure surfaces depend on the writer order; the temporary part is removed after it

source_refs.claim: the retry strategy retries a retryable error up to s3_retry_attempts times
and an outer loop reissues the request up to s3_retry_attempts + 1 times: a request that always fails is sent (s3_retry_attempts + 1)^2 times
s3_retry_attempts defaults to 500: one injected failure is retried once and succeeds
a failed write buffer is cancelled and tries to abort its multipart upload
